profile.headline: Frontend Developer
profile.summary:
I'm Brittany E. Carter, web developer, supervisor, an adventurer, an open-minded conversationalist, an artist, a bit of a risk taker, and a friend of cats.  I have a deep love for development because what’s life if not an opportunity to learn, grow, and create something entirely new.

I started my journey in web development by the impulsive decision to try a coding class. But I never expected coding to lead me to discovering my obsession with creating and watching ideas evolve from their simple inceptions.

Whether I am creating a new style of a website or leading my team to gain a new perspective, my favorite projects have been ones that give the opportunity to learn and get excited about a subject. It is my hope to push front end development further to not only create projects that are easy to use but also allow for the growth of a community! Take my hand and let me show you something cool! View my portfolio at https://brittanyecarter.com/

positions.title: Digital Artist
positions.description: Migrated a large volume of page content from Adobe  Management Service (AMS) to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Cloud Service. Used AI to generate new pages and create new content. Cleaned up any AI errors and styling updates. Provided AEM training, advised, answered any AEM questions. Created, updated, modified, and verified logos, tags, experience fragments, content fragments, navigation, content with a high level of attention to detail and an improvement to efficiency across pages.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Adobe Experience Cloud · Content Development · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: AEM Development Team Supervisor
positions.description:
Managed digital assets and DAM system implementation, configuration, and customization.
Built websites in Adobe Experience Manager. Designed the styling for websites using SASS/CSS Developed style policies using XML. Defined scope and guide problem prevention. Facilitated client walkthroughs with the design team. Lead Asset Management, AEM,SASS, HTML, and Gulp training. Created comprehensive internal documentation. Worked seamlessly in Prod, QA, and development environments. Carefully coded and validated Apache Redirects. Communicated with clients and supervising direct reports in different times zones including EST, CST, and MST. Set team goals that align with the company's vision. Developed best practice and coding standards of the team. Constructed compiler using Gulp.js to compile SASS files to CSS files. Built site structure and content using Adobe Experience Manager. Used HTML5 to create tables and site structure. Collaborated with coworkers using GitHub. Resolved any bugs found by the QA team. Produced form schemas using JSON. Composed screenshots of websites using JSON and postman. Managed content and styling packages for production, quality assurance, and development environments. Deployed the website from develop to stage and production.
